title: This remote makes controlling your phone a breeze
text:
This remote makes controlling your phone a breeze

This controller is convenient for those times where you don't want to stop and pull your phone out just to click a button. Now you won't have to. Thanks to the Bluetooth connectivity, you can pair the controller to your phone and use the controller to change songs and adjust volume. There's no need to use the phone and screen anymore, just wear the controller with the strap provided and everything will be at your fingertips. If you'd like to stick the controller to a surface, such as the dashboard of your car while driving, you can. Thanks to the suction backing, it'll stick and won't slide away.
